item.title: Elon Musk Settles $1M Daily Voter Giveaway Lawsuits
item.description: Elon Musk’s $1 million‑a‑day voter giveaway faced fraud lawsuits, a DA injunction, and a confidential settlement, raising legal and regulatory questions.
